question: How should `/reasoning stream` appear in the TUI: transient chat rewriting, footer/status text, or only the existing Show Thinking history path?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the reporter specifically asked for OpenAI/Grok-style rewriting and then footer/status placement, so automation should not choose the durable TUI presentation contract.

options.title: Transient Chat Reasoning
options.body: Render live thinking as a temporary or updating assistant row during the run, then clear, collapse, or replace it when the final answer arrives.

options.title: Footer Status Reasoning
options.body: Show the latest reasoning delta in the running footer/status area, matching the follow-up request but competing with existing activity and watchdog status.

options.title: History Only
options.body: Do not add live TUI stream presentation and instead align help/docs so users rely on `/reasoning on` plus Show Thinking for durable visibility.

recommendation.title: Transient Chat Reasoning
recommendation.body: Render live thinking as a temporary or updating assistant row during the run, then clear, collapse, or replace it when the final answer arrives.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest available TUI UX routing signal among the likely owners, while the remaining choice is presentation policy rather than only code mechanics.
